premise.claim: The shipped refine mode stores a full enumeration of every instance address in a single RBG-level ConfigMap (~40-120 bytes/entry); a 4000-replica role with 5 pods per instance is ~2.4 MB, beyond the 1 MiB ConfigMap limit, and every scale event rewrites the whole object to every mounting node.
premise.patchedComponent: keps/576-compact-discovery-configmap (docs-only KEP proposing the replacement design)
premise.evidence: reconcileRefinedDiscoveryConfigMap builds one <rbg> ConfigMap via ConfigBuilder.Build() with one entry per pod (pkg/discovery/config_builder.go); arithmetic 4000x5x118B = ~2.36MB > 1MiB. Mechanism-level confirmation; docs PR, not load-tested.
